title: Poojai
desc: A temple priest gives evidence in court about a murder that he has witnessed. Unfortunately for him, he bears witness against an influential landlord.

title: June
desc: June, a teenager, believes that there is nothing remarkable about her. She experiences adolescent crushes, handles heartbreaks and fights insecurities as she grows into a mature and confident woman.

title: Gatta Kusthi
desc: Veera has a preconceived set of criteria for what he wants in a bride. However, he ends up unexpectedly marrying a woman who is the complete opposite of his expectations.

title: Mega Crocodile
desc: A researcher is commissioned to search for a missing person on the Hell Island full of crocodiles but soon find themselves endangered when giant crocodiles begin threatening their lives.

title: Arrambam
desc: Ashok, a former member of the ATS, along with Arjun, a computer hacker, and his girlfriend Anitha, tries to unveil a scam involving the bulletproof jackets provided to police officers.

title: 365 Repeat the Year
desc: A detective and a webtoon artist gets a chance to reset their lives by a year, but their new reality takes an unexpected turn with mysterious and dangerous consequences.

title: Remo
desc: SK, an aspiring actor, falls in love with Kavya, a doctor. However, she is engaged to another man and SK tries to sabotage their relationship by making her fall for him.
